description: Implementation of the BankingService interface providing methods to manage customers, accounts, transactions, and transfers in a banking application. Contains CRUD operations, fund transfer logic, and transaction retrieval functions.

classes.name: BankingServiceImpl
classes.description: Service layer class implementing banking operations such as customer and account management, fund transfer, and transaction retrieval.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all customers in the system as a list of CustomerDetails.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record in the database.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Finds a customer by their customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates details of an existing customer identified by customer number.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer based on customer number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds an account by its account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new bank account for a customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Transfers funds between two accounts for a given customer, with transaction recording.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves all transactions associated with a specific account.
